definitions.gloss: main aim; chief focus; main point
definitions.explanation: The most important point or purpose that something is aimed at. A formal word, used mostly in the set phrase 〜に{主眼|しゅがん}を{置|お}く (to focus mainly on).

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: To put the main emphasis on safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}{力|りょく}→会話力：23778_kaiwaryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧だ。
examples.english: The main aim of this class is to improve conversation skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}かれている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: This reform focuses on raising the quality of service rather than cutting costs.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to focus mainly on ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}かれる→置く：01092_oku⟧: ~ is the main focus
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{主眼|しゅがん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have ~ as the main aim

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重点|じゅうてん}→重点：14416_juuten⟧: emphasis, priority. 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重点|じゅうてん}→重点：14416_juuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ means much the same and is more common; {主眼|しゅがん} stresses the purpose behind the effort and sounds more formal.
- ⟦{狙|ねら}い→狙い：00312_nerai⟧: aim (everyday word)
